status: source-reviewed v1.4 transformations; provider raw-statistic definitions remain separate

common.scope: v1.4 Elo context only. For each source season/week, history contains all supplied earlier seasons and earlier weeks of that season. Elo and reference moments exclude the entire current source week. Current source-game contributions are then rolled into the state used for a later prediction target.
common.elo_equations_excel: Initialize unseen ratings R=0. For each paired completed history game: E=1/(1+POWER(10,-((R_home-R_away)+55)/400)); A=IF(home_margin>0,1,IF(home_margin=0,0.5,0)); M=MIN(2.5,MAX(0.75,LN(ABS(home_margin)+1))); delta=20*M*(A-E); R_home_new=R_home+delta; R_away_new=R_away-delta. Source math.isclose(home_margin,0) is exact for integer score margins.
common.elo_inputs: Paired prior home/away team-game records in supplied chronological order, realized prior home margin (missing coerced to zero), no offseason shrinkage in this implementation. Unmatched teams have rating zero.
common.rating_scale: s_R=STDEV.S(known_team_ratings), replaced by 1 when unavailable/nonfinite or math.isclose(s_R,0). Opponent context is R_opponent/s_R, not a separately recentered z-score.
common.statistic_scale: mu=AVERAGE(nonmissing history statistic), sigma=STDEV.S(nonmissing history statistic); sigma becomes 1 when missing or exactly zero. With no finite history the statistic baseline remains missing, so the ordinary statistic contribution is missing.
common.roll_order: Sort by season, team, week, game ID; roll within team-season; keep the last row for each fingerprint key. Game count includes rows with missing adjusted statistics.
common.ewm_missingness: Equivalent to pandas ewm(alpha=0.45,adjust=False,min_periods=1,ignore_na=False). Before the first finite x, output is missing. Initialize e=x and w=1 on the first finite x. At each later row set w=0.55*w; if x is finite set e=(w*e+0.45*x)/(w+0.45), then w=1. If x is missing, carry e and the decayed w. Without missing rows this reduces to e=0.55*e_previous+0.45*x.
common.garbage_time_handling: No new play-level garbage-time filter; uses supplied canonical game statistics and completed score margins.
common.source_inspiration: TDNet-derived v1.4 Elo-context transformation and transparent temporal consensus; these residuals are not a separately calibrated provider rating.
